name: Flatpak Desktop Environment
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y pcmanfm flatpak && flatpak remote-add --user --if-not-exists flathub https://dl.flathub.org/repo/flathub.flatpakrepo && mkdir -p /config/Downloads && sudo find /config -xdev -exec chown -h $(whoami):$(whoami) {} +
